audit.why: Naafiri-favored throughout (50.37% WR, packet chart Naafiri x7): Taliyah's only self-peel is W, her R is a roam tool not a combat escape. Content layer correct; full-layer chart carried 'Skill' on all rows and disagreed with content.
Spikes 3-5 (all-in vs squishy mage), 6 (R closes, her R can't escape combat), first item, late (still favored, track Weaver's Wall roams) — all four present and kit-accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the matchup's sharpest interaction: dashing through Unraveled Earth (E) detonates the mines and STUNS — Naafiri's E and R dashes through her minefield self-stun. Also the recurring 'W lock-on dive' misdescription of Naafiri's kit, 13 misgender hits, and a digit-free cooldowns field.
audit.why: Riot E text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' W-into-E (knock through mines) is her kill setup and it directly punishes dash commits.
audit.corrected: E-mine dash-stun added to cooldowns/trading/don'ts; dive language moved to R; pronouns fixed.
W 14s rank 1, E 14s flat, R 180s added.
